who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane MX (red tests of const-ast, blaze-watch, blaze-cas, ix-prof)
what: Two things. (1) The brief said to read with Read/Grep/Glob, but this session has no Grep or Glob tool, and Bash is off-limits but for the runner; searching went through the REPL's rg/glob. (2) blaze-cas's page contract (a_lookup_reads_only_the_pages_its_probes_land_on) broke when the lookup moved to blaze_format::rows::seek_from without the old fences: guesses that all land on one side of a key leave the other end of the range at the run's end, and the bisection that follows reads a page a probe (11 pages where 6 is the bound).
cost: about twenty minutes to find the cause in a crate outside the lane's
cause: a lookup moved to its one home lost a piece (the fence) its old home had, and the contract test lives in the old crate, not with the code
whys: rows.rs's own test checks averages (under 3 pages a lookup), not the worst lookup; the worst-case page test stayed in blaze-cas
class: a move to one home that keeps the contract test behind in the caller
prevention: proposed: rows.rs's a_million_even_keys_take_few_probes should also assert the most pages one lookup touches; the fence is in seek_from on disk (trial clean, not admitted by this lane)
